# @three-ws/home-mcp

> Give any MCP assistant safe control of a real Home Assistant house: floors, rooms and live state, the household's own scenes, and service calls behind a physical-action gate that refuses anything which opens the house.

@three-ws/home-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/home-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/home-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/home-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/home-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/home-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
